verdicts.reason: Both cram the whole poster into a 320x50 strip: the body copy and legal block become illegible micro-text, the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow sits below the legal text at bottom right (wrong reading order), and the logo is a barely visible speck. The headline and CTA in the centre hold up in both. A keeps the body copy to a tidier 3-line block. B wraps it into about 6 lines that run nearly from the top edge to the bottom edge, leaving the left column more cramped and ragged.
